english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone who is conceited or self-important.
This is the all-purpose choice for someone who is excessively proud of themselves.
Use this when the emphasis is on having an exaggerated sense of one's own importance.
Use this when “proud” means having an overly high opinion of oneself.

examples.english: They are always vain and think they are better than everyone else.
examples.traditional: 佢成日自大，覺得自己叻過人。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 zi6 daai6 gok3 dak1 zi6 gei2 lek1 gwo3 jan4

examples.english: They are arrogant all the time and look down on people.
examples.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 zi6 daai6 tai2 m4 hei2 jan4

examples.english: Don’t be so narcissistic, thinking the whole world has to do what you say.
examples.traditional: 你唔好咁自大，以為全世界都要聽你支笛。
examples.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 zi6 daai6 ji5 wai4 cyun4 sai3 gaai3 dou1 jiu3 teng1 nei5 zi1 dek6

examples.english: He's so proud, he thinks he knows everything.
examples.traditional: 佢咁自大，成日以為自己乜都識。
